cards.title: Hidden Power
cards.instruction: Act publicly modest while making choices as though you control the outcome.

cards.title: Terms and Conditions
cards.instruction: Treat every offer, favor, feeling, and apology as a negotiation.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm only keeping the family diary. I'll accept your apology for missing my birthday if I choose when you visit at Christmas.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Mum already expects me on Christmas Day.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll put you here for Boxing Day, then. In return, I'll tell her I'm no longer hurt.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'd rather you actually stopped being hurt.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Stay through New Year and I'll mean it. I'll leave your room made up until then, and take the birthday out of my calls to Mum.
